body:
Friend, did you see our email?
---
Now that Deb is the **official** Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico, your support is _more important than ever before._ **[Please, don’t miss your chance to be one of the FIRST in the general election to endorse Deb's campaign for Governor of New Mexico before midnight: Add your name!](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?source=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=1&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)**

---
Thank you,
Team Haaland
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Team Haaland**
Date: Wed, Jun 3, 2026
Subject: will you personally endorse Deb's campaign?
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=3&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)
---
We've got HUGE news, friend: **Deb is officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico!**
This is an incredible milestone, but the fight ahead starts now. National Republicans and GOP megadonors are already preparing to spend millions to flip New Mexico red, and we need to show that this grassroots movement is ready for whatever comes next.
**_
[That’s why we want you to be one of the FIRST in the general election to endorse Deb's campaign for Governor of New Mexico before midnight: Add your name!](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?refcode=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=4&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)_**

---
Deb understands the toughest challenges facing our state, from housing to healthcare. She knows firsthand that the system isn’t working for people the way it should — and that's because that’s been her experience most of her life.
Now more than ever, New Mexico needs a strong leader who is ready to fight from day one to lower costs, protect our freedoms, and make government work better for everyone.

But Deb can't do it alone, friend. We’re building a people-powered movement strong enough to take on the GOP’s attacks and keep New Mexico moving forward — and your endorsement tonight matters. ** _[So please, before midnight tonight, will you be one of the 10,000 supporters we need to endorse Deb Haaland's campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202606_endorse?refcode=jtk837-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&t=6&akid=10113%2E400544%2EssvoaW)_**

In 2024, I ran for Congress in Maryland. I fought as hard as I knew how. I knocked on doors, made calls, and connected with voters.
The voters who heard my message? They were with me.
_The problem was getting heard at all._
Dark money donors spent MILLIONS of dollars to drown me out, and it worked. I watched it happen in real time — ads I couldn't match, mailers I couldn't answer, and a wall of money between me and the voters I was trying to reach.
When you have that kind of money, you don't have to win the argument. You just have to make sure the other side can't be heard.
I could've walked away. God knows it would've been easier.
But I filed to run again.
**I stood inside the United States Capitol on January 6th and watched Donald Trump's mob try to tear our democracy apart with their bare hands. I held the line that day. I testified. I fought back with everything I had.**
And I'll be damned if I let dark money and MAGA intimidation knock me down.
I'm running for this district, for this state, and for the idea that our democracy is worth defending even when it's hard. Especially when it's hard.
That means standing up to Donald Trump. It means standing up to the billionaires and the PACs and the anonymous money that's quietly buying our elections out from under us.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Haaland vs Hull
body:
Plus: Why this race could be over by the Fourth of July | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Xm6aAfAt63u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
`Gregg Hull just won the GOP nomination for New Mexico governor in a real stunner — outspent 3-to-1 by Doug Turner, who had been closing fast in the final week. [He outlasted both Turner and Duke Rodriguez](https://us.list-manage.com/o1rgMvAFLIH?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) by riding huge support across the Albuquerque metro.``
``**Now it's Hull vs. Haaland** — and she just buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout of her own.`
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/rVR_FvHbLgg?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🔥 HULL TAKES THE GOP — KRYSTY WAS RIGHT!**
Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win.
Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode.
There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to?

**🔵 HAALAND THUMPS BREGMAN — NOW SHE GOES UNDERGROUND**
Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane.
Jay's words on her general election plan: she's going to make Joe Biden look like the greatest retail politician ever.
And the warning Jay delivers next should keep Hull's team up at night.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/hEi57dCu58I?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **🎯 HULL'S PUNCHER'S CHANCE — AND THE 2006 PLAYBOOK**
Hull has a path. Mark and Jay walk through it — and Jay keeps coming back to one race: Heather Wilson, 2006.
The catch is a -26 generic ballot in Albuquerque. Hull starts the general in a deep hole. And Jay says if he doesn't move fast, this race could be over by the Fourth of July.

**😬 THE MAINE SENATE CANDIDATE WITH A 20-YEAR NAZI TATTOO**
A Nazi tattoo on his chest. For 20 years. He says it was an accident.
Reddit posts. Sexually explicit messages with other women while married. A wife sent to defend him publicly.
His name is Graham Platner. Democrats are sticking with him because they need to take out Susan Collins. You'll want to hear Mark on this one.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/jSsLfZTdpuS?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)

Peter,

the general election after AIPAC and Big Tech dropped more than $1 million
to attack him in the final days of this heated race for Nancy Pelosi’s
U.S. House seat.

The progressive primary movement we have today wouldn't be possible
without Saikat's leadership. We are proud to be in this fight with him,
always.

Thank you, Saikat, for challenging the Democratic establishment head-on,
building the biggest ground game San Francisco has ever seen, and being
committed to growing the movement to build true power for working people.

There's no clearer sign you're running a campaign that challenges the
billionaire class to deliver a better future for working families than
when AI & Crypto billionaires tag team with AIPAC donors to defeat you.

Though we didn’t get the results we wanted in this race, it’s looking
promising that Mai Vang and Angela Gonzales-Torres will advance to the
general election in Sacramento (CA-07) and Los Angeles (CA-34).

Votes are still being counted, but we need your support to quickly help

“When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.”
| | When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
~ Isaiah 59:19
---
I'm sure I don't really need to tell you this, but we're in a spiritual battle. This isn't a game or some kind of hyperbole; the soul of our nation is on the line right now.
The other day, I read and reflected on Isaiah 59:19. The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos.
My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too.
Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us!

The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him. Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos. My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too. Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us! No matter what my role was, from Navy SEAL to husband and father, I have always led with the light of Christ and that's not about to change when we defend the House in November. This past weekend, I won the official Republican Party of Minnesota endorsement for the United States Senate. Now the real battle begins — and I’m asking you to stand with me.

My name is Adam Schwarze._**I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran who joined the military right after 9/11.**_ I fought in the Battle of Najaf in Iraq and deployed nine times to over 70 countries in defense of this nation. I’m not a career politician — I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who answered the call to serve.

There are two very different futures on the ballot:

**My vision:**
* Secure borders and a peace through strength national defense
* Law and order with full support for our police
* Lower taxes and less government burden on families and small businesses

The general election in California starts now , and I’m proud to be running for re-election to serve as your California Attorney General.
Californians are facing unprecedented challenges. Our fight against relentless attacks from the Trump administration, threats from corporations that think they’re above the law, and rising costs requires a leader with battle-tested experience.
Our next Attorney General has to be ready on day one to shield Californians from brazen attacks on our rights and our families, and continue the critical work of holding accountable bad actors attempting to harm, defraud, or scam the people of our state.
If you’re with me in this fight, I’m asking you to become a day one donor to our general election campaign by contributing any amount right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
Over the last five years, we’ve built a wall of protection around this state. A legal fortress around our freedoms and our values that not even the most unlawful president can tear down.
We’ve put public safety first, and successfully combatted fentanyl traffickers, gun traffickers, and human traffickers.
We’ve held corporations accountable for breaking the law, from Big Tech hurting our children for their own profit to Big Oil’s deceptive practices to Big Landlords colluding to drive up prices.
Through it all, we’re defending our rights, freedoms, and democracy from the ongoing assault of a federal government and President who are hell-bent on tearing them down.
Since his second term began, we’ve sued Donald Trump 68 times — and we’ve won. Again and again and again.
The message is clear: the rule of law is still intact, and remains our best defense against the reckless and dangerous actions of Donald Trump and his corrupt administration — that’s why I am laser-focused on earning another term as your Attorney General.
Together we fight, together we lead — and together, we must finish the job.
I am fiercely committed to doing whatever it takes to stop unlawful power grabs from the federal government, defend our immigrant communities, protect reproductive freedom, safeguard our environment, hold corporations accountable, keep our communities safe from gun violence and fentanyl, and stand up to abuse of power wherever it appears — and to do all that, I’ll need you with me.
Today, as we kick off the general election, please join the fight and become a day one donor. No amount is too small — your contributions add up to make all of this work possible. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being a part of this team and our movement for freedom and justice for all.
—Rob

| Rebecca Bennett here. I just became the Democratic nominee for New Jersey's 7th Congressional District, which means I am officially facing off against Tom Kean Jr. in one of the nation's closest toss-up districts.

[Before I tell you more, will you split a donation between me and the Voter Protection Project to help unseat a vulnerable MAGA extremist and flip the House blue in November? ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=6&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Rebecca Bennett and Voter Protection Project will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110586?t=7&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110600?t=11&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
If this is the first you're hearing from me, hi 👋

**I'm a former U.S. Navy helicopter pilot, officer in the Air National Guard, business leader in healthcare, and proud mom to my two daughters.**
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=12&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
I entered this race for the same reason I joined the military: I love this country.

I was serving on active duty in the military the first time Trump was elected. Seeing the path he sent us on, I knew I had to get involved in politics. As soon as I got out of the military, I started volunteering, door-knocking, and phone banking.

Then Trump got elected _again._

**I knew in that moment no one was coming to save us. I had to throw myself at this problem. For my daughters, for their generation, for the future of the country I love.**

Congress is failing us. It's time to remember that we're the ones cutting their checks. Tom Kean Jr. has proven himself unfit to lead. It's time for him to step aside for someone who has what it takes to stand up to extremism, lower costs, and defend our rights and freedoms.

The Republican establishment tried _hard_ to prevent me from taking home the win last night, but we won out.

I'm not scared of a challenge. I landed aircraft in the middle of the ocean with one foot of clearance in the pitch dark. They can throw whatever they want at us, but I'm not going anywhere.

**I can't wait to show them just who they picked a fight with, and I'd love to have you by my side.**

[Can the Voter Protection Project and I count on you to split a donation to support my General Election Fund? I am up against MAGA millionaires and shady special interest groups vying to buy our voice, and we need all the grassroots strength we can muster to fight back and win in November. ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=13&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
[JOIN THE TEAM »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/110585?t=14&akid=24763%2E878179%2EflCo3W)
---
Thanks for being here!
-Rebecca

name: Kshama for Congress
subject: Kshama is the only consistent antiwar, pro-worker candidate in this race
body:
Working people don’t need more “team players” in Congress, we need a proven fighter

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/kshamasawant/socialists-for-kshama-13701851?e=bbdb764b3a)
---
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
There are now two Democrats and one Republican running against socialist Kshama Sawant in the Congressional District 9 race for Washington state.
---
|
---
| |

**Kshama is the only consistent antiwar, pro-worker candidate in this race.**
**She is the only candidate in the race with a track record of defeating billionaires and winning working-class victories.**
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/xlLtoadrMDv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| [VOLUNTEER](https://us.list-manage.com/12RP5Mlyhym?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| |
Democrat #1 is incumbent Adam Smith, who has spent his nearly three decades in office openly promoting endless war and being bankrolled by the weapons industry, AIPAC, and Big Tech executives. Smith has voted repeatedly to fund the genocide in Gaza and to block United Nations food aid to Gaza. He voted in December of 2025 to give Trump $906 billion for war — money that Trump has been using for the war on Iran and to fund Israel’s assault on Lebanon. Smith has voted to create and fund ICE. He also voted to slash Medicare and Medicaid funding by hundreds of billions of dollars. **Adam Smith needs to go!**
Both the Democratic and Republican parties are using every avenue to try to block Kshama from becoming the first revolutionary socialist in Congress.
**The Republican who filed in the race, Doug Basler, publicly admitted that he was recruited to try to keep Kshama out of Congress.** As he entered the race, two other Republicans conveniently dropped out, clearing the field for Basler to get the entire Republican vote.
It’s not surprising the Republican leadership strongly prefers Adam Smith to Kshama Sawant, since Smith has been a dogged representative of the war profiteers, Zionist lobby, and the billionaire class. **As one right-wing commenter**[**remarked**](https://us.list-manage.com/yipF2PsuzG0?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**, Smith “sounds more like a Republican than a lot of Republicans.”** For the Republican Party, this is not about defeating neoliberal warmonger Smith. No Republican has broken 30 percent of the vote against Smith in 15 years, including Basler himself, who has previously run against Smith many times.
Just this week, Adam Smith and Republican Mike Rogers, the chair of the House Armed Services Committee, jointly announced a new bipartisan war spending bill. **If passed next week, it would mean over a trillion new dollars for wars and a shocking expansion in AI, cyber, biotech, and other weapons for Israel.**
Smith shamelessly serves the war profiteers.
Democrat #2 in the race is Melissa Chaudhry. While purportedly running as an alternative to establishment Democrat Adam Smith, Chaudhry is running a remarkably establishment-friendly campaign.
Chaudhry has a detailed “Issues” page on her website, but **nowhere on it does she call for universal public healthcare or Medicare for All.** She does not call for an end to military aid to Israel. **The words “genocide,” “Gaza,” or “Israel,” or “occupation” do not even appear on that page. Nowhere does she call to abolish or shut down ICE or to stop the deportations.** She merely objects to detaining people “without process,” complaining that “that is not immigration enforcement.” **Chaudhry does not demand student debt cancellation,** instead saying “Cap repayments at 5% of discretionary income.” None of what Chaudhry is calling for is a threat to the Democratic Party establishment.
**Kshama is the only candidate fighting for:**
* **Free universal public healthcare**
* **End all military aid to Israel**
* **Shut down ICE and the detention centers**
* **Stop the data centers**
* **Cancel student and medical debt**
* **Fight AI-related layoffs with a public-sector, living-wage jobs guarantee**
* **National rent control**

These positions are supported by tens of millions of working people, but are frightening to the billionaires and both their political parties.
It’s no accident that Democratic Party candidates don’t run on demands like Kshama’s, because they are trying to build careers and don’t want to antagonize powerful people. They instead speak in vague generalities to which they can’t be held accountable. They know that running a campaign like Kshama’s would put them at odds with party powerbrokers and the billionaires and multimillionaires they serve.
Chaudhry recently spoke at a Democratic Party event, which included a mix of candidates, party establishment stalwarts like Democratic State Senator Jamie Pedersen, activists, and party insiders. **She announced to those present: “I am a team player.”**
**The immediate question this statement raises is “which team?” Because there is no “team” in Congress right now that fights for working people.** There are those who nakedly represent Wall Street and the war industry — in both parties. And then there are those who campaign for marginal change — who don’t want to antagonize party leaders or big business. Both teams are maintaining the rotten status quo in their own ways.
Kshama Sawant is not looking to join either “team,” but to go to war for working people against the billionaires and their political servants as she did for a decade on the Seattle City Council.
Far from having a strategy or willingness to fight the two warmongering parties, Chaudhry has made it clear she’s not prepared to fight in the way that Kshama did during her decade on Seattle City council.
**Chaudhry also has**[**said**](https://us.list-manage.com/XI_4tQCchPU?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**about Adam Smith: “Our incumbent has done some great work on housing.”** She [said](https://us.list-manage.com/_X4atCfmgqc?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) about herself and Adam Smith: “In many fronts, we are aligned, honestly. So if you like how he votes for Green New Deal and housing and education stuff, you will like how I vote for all of that.”
NO, working people DON’T like how Adam Smith voted on all that stuff! Adam Smith voted to break the strike of the Railroad workers in 2022. He voted for hundreds of billions of dollars in cuts to Medicare and Medicaid. Under both Republican President Bush and Democratic President Obama, Adam Smith repeatedly voted to bail out the big banks after the Great Recession, which plundered the millions who faced home foreclosures and handed over tens of billions of dollars worth of real estate to private equity. This bipartisan robbery against working people is a big reason why rents have been skyrocketing. In 2011, Adam Smith voted to cut nearly a hundred billion dollars for various programs, including billions of dollars of cuts to publicly funded rent controlled housing.
How can working people trust someone who says they are in any way aligned with a politician who is literally bankrolling the genocide in Gaza and calling antiwar activists “[left-wing fascists](https://us.list-manage.com/F0dyj3ewIMK?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)”?
Adam Smith needs to go. Anyone who thinks Smith has done “great work” is not going to fight for the fundamental change we desperately need. Kshama is the only consistently anti-war, pro-worker candidate in this race. And she’s the only candidate with a record of taking on the billionaires and their political servants and defeating them.
Chaudhry [said,](https://us.list-manage.com/H4G54qsIWPK?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15) in reference to Congress: “I cannot change the makeup of 535 people right now. I cannot convince 535 people of anything, but I can become one of them. Right?”
**That’s exactly wrong.** Kshama has shown what we need: a principled elected representative who will fight unambiguously for working people and use her elected office to build mass movements. Organized, militant, mass movements are what the Democrats and Republicans fear most of all and the only thing that forces them to concede. The last thing working and oppressed people need is another candidate campaigning to go to Congress to “become one of them.”
Seeking peace with the party leadership only leads to one thing: betraying working people.
We need to fight all out for every vote for Kshama in this election, by building the strongest grassroots canvassing campaign that Congressional District 9 has ever seen. We need to talk to hundreds of thousands of people about why our campaign represents the only real alternative to this rotten status quo, and why we need to elect a proven fighter like Kshama.
Volunteer, donate, and get involved in our historic campaign to elect the first-ever revolutionary socialist to the U.S. Congress.
In solidarity,Kshama for Congress

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1896, Henry Ford unveiled and test-drove [the Quadricycle](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFywyAQBNCvQZ00CGEkFxRp1DltSs0ZDutiDA6crdHfZ5RfSLfFm52d_bosF6BI6fYJD7Qc8pJwqxGZsSxUIFUudMd6f21AXLMjiBUXJZVppWmlXjxQ3BfdeBsQFQ4N2n6c5MmMY39qVqum4JzTvdMBjHfBjXAdNFwn0wNoc27IHm3SSN1LOQ26w35ybpC9PMMo4eSFluiJc-m-MyVeMcQ9v7F0Lj-aaFfmZxXDh1CzULPL5ZkLMHYhF38QoWYoTC5iFWpeqXIu-5Ewlb09VG1vBYGxcksp5Tcw5dTyiu3PC3wht7uIQs3btgk1N8X650YxUjWj0PL2AIp_W_hfB76t-g0AAP__B8aIsw), the first automobile he designed. The successful 4 a.m. trial run behind his Detroit home helped launch the future automotive pioneer's career. The New York Public Library is celebrating America's 250th birthday by brewing beer from a 269-year-old [recipe written by George Washington himself](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQAL8GOqO1AZsULq6hy7VXosUsZC-OjWwnFn9_yv3C60ej0fy5L3dkz-H4jS-yZY9LoJo9lUJp4YQhl8RPys93RS45OkafaVGgtAAtYFg2ZH8tQ7vZnUhR35KVZoJRGyPH9mFRaj3hzezTIHenVurBoBnB9Fuv5Shbtl8baBgkwNQPHcnJuR4k3NAAjlszAG1cYur-Rg7lQbu_4odS5-Kr9fZRypmb_lej5kbNtdYuXKfvYjoaNZ-Jcm7UHKiKK6anON-rZyc8rwnTJTBsoqAnFCtREi4KDCG-g6MvQqlcwuNBqU12Oyt7z1mbZoDjhez_B5QfXftY9S8AAP__hVuDJQ). The low-alcohol brew was meant to keep troops hydrated when they couldn't trust the water. A local brewery is making two versions: one faithful to the original and one with modern tweaks for those who aren't feeling the molasses. Convention season is over, but the election season is just beginning...

#### **I AM RUNNING TO BE YOUR NEXT STATE AUDITOR.**

I have steadfastly communicated my intention to run straight through the August primary. That’s why I filed for candidacy last week ahead of the convention. No games, no buckling, no capitulating to a system with shifting rules and fuzzy deadlines. My team and I remain steadily on course.

---
---
Now it’s time for ALL VOTERS to get in the arena. Join me!

---
#### **The majority of Minnesota voters (99%) haven’t cast a vote yet! **
---
The August Primary offers EVERY voter an opportunity to select the candidate who will appear on the November ballot (not just the 1% who attended the convention).

I am eager for EVERY voice to be heard. Afterall, it’s the******ENDORSEMENT OF ALL MINNESOTANS** that truly matters!

**FUNDRAISING DOMINANCE, STATEWIDE NAME RECOGNITION,
AND SOLID EXPERIENCE SPANNING 40 YEARS...**
**
THESE ARE ESSENTIAL FACTORS FOR A STATEWIDE CANDIDATE TO WIN!!!**

💲While I will continue to fundraise for the general election, my campaign is financially well-positioned to run through the August 11 primary.

🙋My statewide name recognition, massive social media presence (+1 million followers), and database of over 192,000 supporters make reaching voters a CERTAINTY that my opponents can’t claim.

💼 For more than 40 years, I have built a record of LEADERSHIP, ACCOUNTABILITY & SERVICE:

* As a 10+ year **Audit Chair** for a $1 BILLION bank, I helped oversee financial controls, risk management, and accountability.

* As a **MN State Senator** , I helped oversee one of the largest portions of Minnesota's budget and fought to bring greater transparency to government.

* As a school board chair, business owner, physician, husband, father, and grandfather, I’ve spent my life making decisions that affect real people and real budgets.

**Visit my website for more information on my extensive experience:** [
Scott's Experience](http://email.mg.drscottjensen.com/c/eJxkz72O2zAQBOCnERuDxnL5tyxYHAIYKdKnDJZ_tgJJNERe_PqBr71uMPiKGf4saz1y_bOWiMoqFLkfk_N8F8qW1Iwy0qPP0jSqki03mVizSlQ4IIsSWwmom6hReQLrgQyJR8zI5JX2FCqwZ1VJezRE4AM1bVCsEQEdODBKARh_RShsvUmWtKLgw2Jgv1_LOXKf8289Rj2uue9ii485n2PRHwveFry9Xq_vasEbp_45r4-5b2KvY_D96yWEDOxTkrUxSgNQZXKgJKXsVC4QSiLRz_vbksbinEfZsKE0ZIMkaChdIJXZllaTFmcsz9e6betwfjFw33ndvnbO-Ovnoj8uvy9Hv5R-9HPBH-_8POsY4l_E_wEAAP__E8FyWQ) **
Winning this race is more than an endorsement...
**
It is about who can effectively communicate with voters across Minnesota.

It is about who can win a statewide election.

And most importantly, it is about who can restore confidence that our government is operating lawfully, efficiently, and transparently on behalf of taxpayers.

**⬆️ That is why I am running.
**
Over the coming weeks, I'll continue traveling the state, meeting voters, sharing my vision for the Auditor's Office, and earning your support.

If you would like to support these efforts, we invite you to consider making a contribution. Every donation helps us continue our work and reach more people.
[Dr. Scott Jensen | Donate to Further the Cause](http://email.mg.drscottjensen.com/c/eJwkj0-LHCEQRz9Ne1kctPxXHjwsgSGH3HMMpaWzHaZ1aN3k64fe3IrHe1A_-uS99lJ_7ZxAOw2ijL6orAtox7lZbWWAUKRtWCU5ajKTIZ2RKQIJTo0jmCZq0gGVCwotio9kHKFD68GTK-iNNj5SYONs4xwxiz2BAq-8slorZcMNFJMLNjs0GmOIm1XH48bnLGOt37XP2m9lHOKZPtZ6zc28b3Df4D5r-TzrjXrlsS7jYlcj_0eyjVMee-91jkUb3Hl0WlUcdU56fE1XsSgKOcvaCKRVqsrslZaYi9eFVeSMYpyPy0UD7H0A2aCBtOiiRNVA-oi6kONWsxFn4tff_fncpw-bVY-D9ufX8yv9-L6Z97efb3288ejj3ODbdb_OOqf4k-BfAAAA___LFXo2)
Minnesota taxpayers deserve an auditor who understands both the public and private sectors, and who has a proven record of LEADERSHIP.

Thank you for standing with me. Together, we can bring experienced leadership, fiscal accountability, and common-sense oversight back to state government.

Sincerely,

Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for State Auditor
